test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is a Private Sector Undertaking of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Housing Development Finance Corporation Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• HDFC Ltd. to merge into HDFC Bank effective July 1, 2023
 
• In a significant development, the merger between Housing Development Finance Corporation Ltd and HDFC Bank Ltd has successfully obtained final board approval.
 
• With a valuation of around USD 40 billion, this unprecedented merger creates a financial services powerhouse.
 
• HDFC Investments Limited and HDFC Holdings Ltd merged with HDFC Limited.
 
• HDFC Limited merged with HDFC Bank Limited has became effective from July 1, 2023.
 
• After merging with the mortgage lender HDFC, HDFC Bank is set to become the world's fourth most valuable bank based on market capitalization and emerge as the second biggest company in India.
 
• Deepak Parekh, the esteemed chairman of Housing Development Finance Corporation (HDFC), has announced his retirement as HDFC prepares to merge with HDFC Bank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• HDFC Bank__

• HQ - Mumbai
 
• CMD - Shasidhar Jagdishan
